definitions.gloss: set-piece fireworks; fireworks display mounted on a frame
definitions.explanation: Fireworks fixed to a frame on the ground or water that burn to show pictures, words or waterfalls of sparks, as opposed to shells launched into the sky.

examples.japanese: {仕掛|しか}け{花火|はなび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ナイアガラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕掛|しか}け{花火|はなび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: A "Niagara" set piece poured down sparks above the river.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花火大会|はなびたいかい}→花火大会：10105_hanabitaikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる→浮かび上がる：06858_ukabiagaru⟧{仕掛|しか}け{花火|はなび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the fireworks festival, you can see a set piece that spells out words.

notes:
⟦{仕掛|しか}け→仕掛け：07916_shikake⟧ (device, contrivance) + ⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧ (fireworks). A familiar part of summer fireworks festivals in Japan.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ナイアガラ⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧: "Niagara" fireworks, a curtain of sparks falling like a waterfall
- ⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ{花火|はなび}→打ち上げ花火：19015_uchiagehanabi⟧: aerial fireworks, the shells launched into the sky
- ⟦{手持|ても}ち→手持ち：07433_temochi⟧⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧: handheld fireworks
